name: seatly
description: Plataforma de eventos e ingressos (desafio Elite Dev)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run start:dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix client
scripts.lint:check: npm run lint:check --prefix server && npm run lint:check --prefix client
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix server && npm run test --prefix client
scripts.test:cov: npm run test:cov --prefix server && npm run test:cov --prefix client
